name: verify_employee_auth
description: verify_employee_auth: Authenticate a standard employee using their employee ID and date of birth. Returns the caller's first and last name on success, or an authentication failure if the credentials do not match.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271

date_of_birth.description: The employee's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 1986-03-04
